args.summary: checkout-api (v2.3.1) failed health checks in all production regions (us-east, us-west, eu-west) with an 18% error rate following the latest deploy. Mitigation: rolled back all production regions to v2.3.0, the most recent known-healthy release. Post-rollback status verified healthy in all regions with error rate back to 0.2%. Follow-up: investigate root cause of v2.3.1 regression before attempting redeploy.
args.title: checkout-api unhealthy after v2.3.1 deploy — rolled back to v2.3.0

trace.final:
All done. Here's a summary:

**What happened:**
- checkout-api v2.3.1 (the latest deploy) was failing health checks in all three production regions (us-east, us-west, eu-west) with an 18% error rate.
- The most recent healthy production release was **v2.3.0**.

**Actions taken:**
1. **Rolled back** checkout-api to v2.3.0 in all production regions — the rollback was verified as rolled out.
2. **Verified recovery** — service is now healthy in all regions with the error rate back to 0.2%.
3. **Opened incident INC-0001** (SEV2) describing the v2.3.1 failure and the mitigation, and the on-call engineer has been paged.

**Follow-up:** The incident remains open for root-cause analysis of the v2.3.1 regression before any redeploy attempt.
